rationale: The pain is real and frequent — content curators and platform operators encounter AI-generated submissions daily — but the market is already served by established, well-funded competitors (Originality.ai, GPTZero, Copyleaks) with stronger detection models. The source signal is an HN feature-request thread aimed at HN itself, not direct buyer complaints about inadequate tooling. Critically, using Claude as a general-purpose AI-content detector carries unacceptable false-positive risk that would erode buyer trust, and no credible differentiation exists to justify a new entrant at this stage.
